answer: Proof-of-diverse-provenance: each epoch the chain sprays every agent a distinct random shard drawn from a vast public data ocean and demands a timed digest pulse in return. A sybil fleet sharing one backend still has to compute every shard independently — masks cannot share the work — so faking N identities costs N times the real throughput, not one. Honest nodes answer their single shard cheaply; a jade-green liveness graph then collapses rewards for any cluster returning suspiciously correlated digests.
